original_prompt:
Create a NEW crisp high-detail full-length studio photograph of the exact individual in the approved chest-portrait reference. Reference role: identity, hairstyle, upper clothing, skin texture and brightness ONLY. Freshly generate the complete photographic scene. Do not retouch, stretch, sharpen or upscale any old full-body picture. Strictly frontal upright head and body, level shoulders, eyes looking straight at camera. Relaxed neutral expression, arms at sides, empty anatomically correct hands. Head through shoe soles entirely visible; subject fills 94% of frame height. Undistorted 85mm portrait-lens appearance, vertical camera with no tilt. Pure white seamless studio, soft grounded shadow, bright even neutral lighting and clear fully illuminated face matching the chest reference. Deep focus, crisp iris edges, eyelashes, lip microtexture, separate hair strands, detailed fingers, fabric weave and seams. Photographic natural skin, no blur, smearing, plastic smoothing or sharpening halos. One person, no labels, text, borders, watermark, collage or props. Native portrait 1024x1536, aspect ratio 2:3. Match a crisp professional character-library studio photo, never a thumbnail. Keep edges and fine facial details genuinely resolved, not softened, painterly or noisy.
PROPORTIONS: Adult anatomy: approximately 7.5 anatomical heads from skull crown to soles, healthy naturally tall body. Head proportional to healthy shoulder width, ribcage and hips. Balanced torso and naturally long thighs and calves, normal feet. Avoid short legs, oversized head, shrunken shoulders/body, tiny head, and excessively stretched legs. Natural high waist; correctly fitted upper garment without visually low waist.
IDENTITY: Preserve the approved chest portrait exactly, including latest facial corrections. Descriptive context: Long brown half-up waves with curtain bangs, blue-gray eyes, soft smile. Slight variation: warm chestnut half-up twists, pale buttery-yellow modest square-neck blouse, tiny lavender pendant.
LOWER OUTFIT: ivory high-waisted straight-leg trousers and beige low-heeled shoes. Keep the reference upper garment, hairstyle, eye color, complexion and accessories. Identity and garments must remain consistent with existing matching views.

COMPOSITION STANDARD: complete body nearly fills the frame vertically, crown at 3% and soles at 97% height. True-to-life neutral proportions, face large enough to read. Photographic clarity of eyes and fabric, moderate contrast, no haze or washed-out face. Sharp from face to shoes.
